integrity: Analytical all-positive-real-gap proof with complete normalization, independent direct exact-rational sampling checks on 3119 nondegenerate finite profiles; literature comparison with two primary full-text source sections. All source authorship credited.
scientific_limitations: Real-line nearest-facility additive social cost; exactly k+1 agents, k>=2 facilities, nonzero optimum; performance of the specified Product-Gap rule only. No result for arbitrary population sizes, dimensions, or incentive compatibility for k>=4. Sharp value is a nonattained supremum; independent validation not performed.
title: Sharp first-surplus approximation ratio for the Product-Gap facility mechanism
